The playbook defines the Enterprise onboarding range as **8–10 weeks**, as stated in [NL-005#NL-005-S02] and [NL-031#NL-031-S02] (target timeline for Enterprise is "8 - 10 weeks").

The observed Enterprise average onboarding duration is **8.7 weeks**, as reported in [NL-012#NL-012-S06] and confirmed by the segment average calculation in [NL-031#NL-031-S03] (average of 8.2, 8.4, 9.5 weeks = 8.7 weeks). This observed average falls within the playbook's target range.

The observed Enterprise duration is longer than simpler plans (Starter: 3.5 weeks, Growth: 5.2 weeks) because Enterprise onboarding involves compliance and security complexities that Starter and Growth plans do not require. Specifically, Enterprise onboarding is frequently delayed by security reviews, custom data-retention configurations, single sign-on (SSO) setups, and the need to process scanned PDF policies that require OCR [NL-012#NL-012-S06]. Furthermore, Enterprise implementations require custom data processing agreements (DPAs), nested Active Directory/Okta permission sync configurations, and processing of scanned legacy documents requiring OCR [NL-005#NL-005-S02]. The primary blockers cited are Permission Mapping (45% of delays), Source Ingestion Cleanup (30%), and OCR Processing (25%) [NL-012#NL-012-S06], [NL-015#NL-015-S04]. Enterprise accounts also get extensions like custom SSO/directory integrations, advanced OCR queues, custom DPA validation, BYOK, and up to 3 weeks of formal UAT [NL-005#NL-005-S09]. In contrast, simpler Starter or Growth plans typically upload clean, public-facing FAQ documents and do not require complex permission mapping or security integration [NL-012#NL-012-S06], [NL-031#NL-031-S02].
